headline: Indonesia's fiscal re-allocation under President Prabowo delivers $30 billion impact without higher borrowing
summary: Under President Prabowo, Indonesia's 2025 fiscal restructuring focused on spending rationalisation and revenue recovery. It delivered an estimated $30 billion fiscal impact while keeping the deficit within the 3% ceiling.
why: Indonesia is Southeast Asia's largest economy, and its fiscal discipline and deficit rules influence sovereign bond and rupiah assessments.
